text:
alex: APAC p99 jumped after the 02:10 deploy, seeing ~3.2s tail for infer requests. Networking looked a bit noisy but queue math also points to underprovisioned GPU pool. Anyone got a quick capacity take?
sana: I started digging — nginx errors minimal, most requests hit high service time not errors. We have a lot of cold GPU churn + some cross-region egress fallback to eu1.
mike: numbers pls (q depth, ingress rate, per-GPU throughput) so we can calc admit curve.
alex: quick stats: sustained ingress ~720 rpm, median batch size 2.1, effective throughput per GPU ~160 rpm (with current batching), avg queue depth ~18, short bursts to ~40. Observed p99 ~3200ms, target p99 <=2000ms.
julie: rough ask: what's the delta GPU-hours to get p99 back under 2s (and cost delta)?
alex: rough calc: baseline pool 5 GPUs => capacity 800 rpm; but with cold-start overhead and variance you need an extra safety margin. If we size to 1.25x capacity for tail, need ~6.25 -> 7 GPUs. So delta = +2 GPUs.
  2 GPUs * 24h = 48 GPU-hours/day. At $3/GPU-hour -> +$144/day (~$4.3k/mo).
  Note: if we prewarm fractional slots (keep 2 prewarm reserved) we reduce cold-start p99 a lot; that cost already included in 2 GPUs.
capacity-bot: I deployed 2 prewarm instances to apac-stage as an experiment, monitoring p99/queue depth.
alex: proposed runtime policy: soft-admit at 0.6 (admit until expected queueing pushes p95 close to target), emergency fallback route to eu1 when admit < 0.3. This keeps some traffic local but prevents catastrophic tail.
mike: can you drop a tiny sim? run admission vs p99 table?
alex: pasted quick sim below:
```
# tiny admit sim (toy)
requests_per_min = 720
gpu_throughput_rpm = 160
cold_overhead_ms = 1200
service_ms = 300
for admit in [0.9,0.75,0.6,0.45,0.3]:
    load = requests_per_min * (1-admit)
    effective_capacity = 7 * gpu_throughput_rpm * admit
    queue_depth = max(0, load/effective_capacity * 20)  # very rough
    p99 = service_ms + cold_overhead_ms*(1-admit) + queue_depth*15
    print(f"admit={admit:.2f} p99={int(p99)}ms qd~{int(queue_depth)}")
```
Output (toy):
admit=0.90 p99=1710ms qd~1
admit=0.75 p99=1965ms qd~3
admit=0.60 p99=2364ms qd~6
admit=0.45 p99=2901ms qd~10
admit=0.30 p99=3570ms qd~16

alex: From this quick run, soft-admit=0.6 keeps us close-ish but might exceed p99 target on big bursts; 0.75 seems safer but costs more (more admitted load = need more GPUs).
sana: important: if admit drops and we fallback to eu1, egress + latency cost spikes. Need egress quota check in the policy.
julie: agree. Also add an alert if admit trending down >10% in 5m window.
mike: will run a more realistic sim with arrival variance and post numbers to this thread in ~30m. For now ack and thanks. :thumbsup:
capacity-bot: Monitoring hook created: apac.pool.prewarm=2, alert if p99 > 2000ms for 5m.
